title: Baked Ziti
subtitle: Cheesy pasta bake for the table
description: The kind of spread that ends the "what's for dinner?" argument fast. Mediterranean vegetarian crew dinner for 8 — about 45 min. Works great when you've got one person on the stove and another on sides.

ingredients.name: ziti
ingredients.notes: 0.5 lbs ziti 1/2 lb ziti (or other shape pasta)

ingredients.name: ricotta cheese
ingredients.notes: 16 oz ricotta cheese 16 ounces ricotta cheese

ingredients.name: mozzarella cheese
ingredients.notes: 3 cups mozzarella cheese 3 cups mozzarella cheese , grated

ingredients.name: spaghetti sauce
ingredients.notes: 3 cups spaghetti sauce 3 cups spaghetti sauce

ingredients.name: parmesan cheese
ingredients.notes: 0.5 cups parmesan cheese 1/2 cup parmesan cheese , grated

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 35 Watch color and texture — if it smells sharp or looks pale, give it another minute before moving on.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Boil ziti or other pasta, i.e. rigatoni, penne, farfalle, rotini, following package directions, drain and place in a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: To ricotta, add salt and pepper (about 1tsp each), dried parsley and blend.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Mix all the ricotta cheese and half of the mozzarella with the ziti.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Spray a 13x9 pan with Pam. Watch color and texture — if it smells sharp or looks pale, give it another minute before moving on.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Cover the bottom half of the pan with about half the sauce. Watch color and texture — if it smells sharp or looks pale, give it another minute before moving on.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Put the ziti mixture on top of sauce. Watch color and texture — if it smells sharp or looks pale, give it another minute before moving on.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Pour remaining sauce on top of ziti. Watch color and texture — if it smells sharp or looks pale, give it another minute before moving on.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Sprinkle with the parmesan cheese. Watch color and texture — if it smells sharp or looks pale, give it another minute before moving on.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: Top with the remaining mozzarella cheese. Watch color and texture — if it smells sharp or looks pale, give it another minute before moving on.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: Bake for 20-30 minutes until cheese is melted and it is lightly golden.

proTips: Keep a backup tray warm in the oven for late calls — nothing worse than cold protein after a run.
Taste for salt at the end — hall palates run salty after long shifts.
tonightSpread: Plate Baked Ziti with sides in separate pans so the crew can mix portions.
Line up Baked Ziti on the main counter with serving spoons — firefighters grab fast between calls.
Keep a backup tray warm in the oven at 200°F for late arrivals after a run.
leftovers: Cool leftovers in shallow containers within two hours — deep pots stay hot too long.
Label trays with date and reheat to 165°F minimum before second shift.
Add a splash of stock or water when reheating — thick sauces tighten in the fridge.
